page: Microsoft Azure D32ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 16 physical cores and hyper-threading. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 480 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 1890 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong performance characteristics. Single-core performance is notable, with Geekbench single-core scores reaching top-tier levels. Multi-threaded capabilities are also strong, as evidenced by a Passmark CPU score of 54563.93 and a bzip3 multi-threaded decompression rate of 231.56 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only small block speeds of 2684.62 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds of 65.26 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the processor's Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 support contribute to strong prompt processing speeds in small and medium LLM inference models.

The D32ds_v7 offers a balanced resource density, combining dedicated high-frequency compute with substantial local storage capacity. This configuration provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring both active processing power and fast local disk access without the need for external storage overhead. The server is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and intermediate-scale language model inference.
